summary: End-to-end testing of Consecrated Hands nonprofit site. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed (config, donations one_time+monthly, contact w/ all 5 interests, prayer, validation). Frontend: all 8 routes load with 0 console errors; Home shows 5 pillars (Faith/Family/Finance/Fitness/Future) and 4 impact counters animate on scroll; Contact/Volunteer/Mentorship/Prayer forms all POST successfully; Donate flow correctly builds Stripe Checkout session and redirects browser to checkout.stripe.com; FAQ accordion expand/collapse works; /donation/success handles missing session gracefully; mobile hamburger menu opens and shows all nav links; floating donate button present.

/api/config computes stripe_enabled from STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env; if key removed, checkout endpoint would 502 while config still reads sensibly. OK but couple them.
PayPal correctly gated (paypal_enabled=false) — expected per spec.
Mongo _id properly excluded via projection ({'_id': 0}) — good.
No obvious duplication; server.py ~280 lines and well-structured.
test_credentials: None required. Stripe test mode active (test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 for manual verification).
seed_data_creation: None; test payloads prefixed with TEST_ inserted into mongo (donations/inquiries/prayers) via API.
